column1: # Vietnamese (vi) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Vietnamese video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product
# UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Product, format and feature names (FilmCraft,
# ArtCraft, Lumetri, Essential Graphics, Essential Sound, AAF, EDL, FCPXML, OMF, OpenTimelineIO,
# timecode, clip, proxy, Remix…) keep their spelling. This catalog covers every menu; anything else
# Terms: track = kênh, bin = kho, marker = điểm đánh dấu, playhead = đầu phát, In/Out = điểm vào /
# điểm ra, transition = chuyển tiếp, frame hold = đứng hình, panel = bảng điều khiển, workspace =
# không gian làm việc, sequence = chuỗi, timeline = dòng thời gian, render = kết xuất, export = xuất,
# caption = phụ đề, transcript = bản chép lời, guide = đường tham chiếu, snap = dính, ripple = dồn,
# metadata = siêu dữ liệu, footage = tư liệu, media = phương tiện. View = Xem, Appearance = Giao diện.
# Menus use the bare verb ("Lưu", "Thêm kênh"); a trailing "…" is kept from the English source.
# Native review: not recorded — entries were produced from the English meaning and need a native
# Vietnamese editor to confirm terminology (kênh/chuỗi/kho are the conservative choices).
